note: Set A is preferred because it faithfully reproduces quote text and accurately captures revision history, whereas Set B fabricates quote content ('SNAP MAIN BREAKER') and engineering values ('100 A'). Both sets suffer from significant errors mapping Wiring Symbols 20 and 50 to their legend definitions (swapping CU/AL and sizes), but Set B's hallucinations make it less reliable. Set A also correctly identifies the Junction Box enclosure type, while Set B misclassifies it as a DC Disconnect.
